name: TradingAgents
description: Multi-agent trading research framework that mimics a trading firm with analysts, debating researchers, a trader and risk managers.
whatItDoes: Analyses a ticker for a given date and produces a trade decision with supporting reasoning. It is intended for research into LLM-based trading, not as financial advice.
howItWorks: A LangGraph workflow runs fundamental, sentiment, news and technical analysts, then bull and bear researchers debate before a trader, risk team and portfolio manager decide. An interactive CLI selects tickers, models and depth, and market data comes from configurable vendors.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: One LLM provider key is needed; Google, Anthropic, xAI, DeepSeek and OpenRouter are alternatives

requirements.name: Python
requirements.description: Python 3.13 conda environment in the documented setup

models: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, local
